jobs.title: System Administrator with Google Workspace Experience
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for a Google Workspace (GWS) System Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize enterprise Google Workspace environments. In this role, you will handle user lifecycle operations, establish security policies, configure identity and access management (IAM), and monitor domain logs to ensure seamless collaboration and data security. Key Responsibilities GWS & IAM Administration: Manage user provisioning, group configurations, organizational units (OUs), licensing, and role-based access control (RBAC). Policy & Security Governance: Implement, update, and enforce workspace policies, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), multi-factor authentication (2FA/MFA), session controls, and email security protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Audit, Logs & Monitoring: Monitor audit logs, track platform security alerts, investigate operational anomalies, and generate compliance reports. Incident & Operational Support: Troubleshoot identity, calendar, drive, and email routing issues; provide escalated tier-2/tier-3 administrative support. Platform Enhancement: Support administration across connected workspace tools and enterprise features (e.g., Chrome Enterprise, Google Gemini Enterprise integrations).

We're looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Manila team, one of the world's leading branded merchandise companies. You'll work directly alongside global Account Managers, helping deliver merchandise programs for some of the biggest brands in the world. This is a coordination and client support role at its core, and a proven launchpad into a career in sales. Room to Grow Your Career The Sales Coordinator role is a strong foundation for building a career with the client. Coordinators who want to move toward Sales typically progress into an Associate Account Manager role, and from there, into other client-facing or leadership positions within Sales Operations. Progression depends on individual readiness, performance, and business needs, but there's a real, well-supported path for coordinators who want to grow.

jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service.
